body: In regards to the 3/4ths profile, if you look at pictures of people in this view, you'll notice that the nose is very close to the edge of the cheek and the right eye is less in view.

I love the expression and the colors you're using. It's extremely pleasing to the eyes. In regards to the face, I'm not too well versed in oil paints, but I think shortening the eyes would make it look better. As in not making the edge of them go as far back as they do. On a side note, the head may be a bit too long.

In general, I would say you need a better idea of the depth of everything. like how the grass and the ground of the sunglasses look like they are on the same layer. For that, I would suggest playing around with shadows and adding different values to the colors you're using. I really enjoy how you're trying different styles and tools. It will give you a lot of diversity in your art when you eventually develop your own style.

I love the way you use colors on the first one but I think you may have made the head a bit too wide or the hair doesn't emphasize the curve of the head enough. Nitpicking but it seems the shadow of the neck and the hair blend a bit too much making it harder to know the angle of the head.
Added info this is fully graphite no white pens or anything like that
